s2.title: Fill in the details
s2.text: Names, date, venue, photos and music — all from your phone.

s3.title: Share the link
s3.text: After payment the invitation goes live. Send the link on Telegram or any messenger.

q1.a: Creating and previewing are free. You pay when you publish, at the price of the design you chose.

q2.q: How do I send it to guests?
q2.a: Once published, your invitation gets its own link. Send it on Telegram, WhatsApp or by SMS — guests don't need to install anything.

q3.q: Can I edit it after publishing?
q3.a: Yes. Change the time, venue or photos any time; the link stays the same.

q4.q: How long does the invitation stay online?
q4.a: For one month after the event. Then the invitation and its photos are permanently deleted.

q5.q: What happens to an unfinished draft?
q5.a: Drafts not edited for 24 hours are deleted automatically. You can keep up to 30 drafts at a time.

Islamic.text: By the grace of Allah, we joyfully invite you to the nikah of our children {groom} and {bride}. Your presence and prayers would mean a great deal to us.
Islamic.ayahTranslation: And among His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.
